title.en: Spinal cord compression from metastatic cancer
title.zh: 转移性癌症引起的脊髓压迫

summary.en:
A 61-year-old woman with a three-year history of stage IV non-small cell lung cancer with known osseous metastases to the thoracic spine (T6, T8) and ribs is admitted to the oncology unit from the emergency department. She was diagnosed with bone metastases eight months ago and has been receiving palliative radiation and systemic therapy. She has a history of well-controlled hypertension managed with amlodipine 5 mg daily and a 30-pack-year smoking history. Home medications include dexamethasone 4 mg PO daily (recently tapered from a higher dose after her last radiation cycle), oxycodone 10 mg PO every 6 hours as needed for back pain, ondansetron 4 mg PO every 8 hours as needed, enoxaparin 40 mg subcutaneous daily for VTE prophylaxis, and a bisphosphonate infusion monthly. She presents because her back pain has changed in character and intensity over the past 48 hours, and she is having new difficulty walking. Current admission orders include IV normal saline at 75 mL/hr, continuation of home medications, neurological checks every 4 hours, fall precautions, and a stat MRI of the entire spine with and without contrast.

The patient reports that her usual mid-thoracic back pain, which she describes as a dull ache rated 4 out of 10 and typically relieved by oxycodone, has escalated over the past two days to a sharp, band-like pain across her mid-back radiating around both flanks, now rated 8 out of 10 and no longer relieved by her usual oxycodone dose. She states that this morning she noticed her legs felt "heavy and clumsy" when she tried to walk to the bathroom, and she stumbled twice. She denies any recent falls or trauma. She appears anxious and is lying very still in bed, reluctant to move because movement worsens the pain. She says she has not had a bowel movement in three days but attributes this to her opioid use. She notes that when she urinated this morning, the stream seemed weak and she felt she did not fully empty her bladder.
summary.zh:
一名61岁女性，有3年IV期非小细胞肺癌病史，已知有胸椎（T6、T8）和肋骨骨转移，从急诊科收治入肿瘤科病房。她在8个月前被诊断出骨转移，并一直接受姑息性放疗和全身治疗。她有高血压病史，控制良好，每天口服氨氯地平5 mg，并有30包·年的吸烟史。家庭用药包括每天口服地塞米松4 mg（最近一次放疗周期后从较高剂量逐渐减量）、必要时每6小时口服羟考酮10 mg缓解背痛、必要时每8小时口服昂丹司琼4 mg、每天皮下注射依诺肝素40 mg预防静脉血栓栓塞，以及每月输注一次双膦酸盐。她因过去48小时内背痛的性质和强度发生变化，并新出现行走困难而就诊。目前的入院医嘱包括静脉滴注生理盐水75 mL/hr、继续使用家庭药物、每4小时进行一次神经系统检查、采取防跌倒措施，以及立即进行全脊柱平扫及增强MRI检查。

患者报告，她通常的胸椎中段背痛（她描述为钝痛，评分为4/10，通常可通过羟考酮缓解）在过去两天里加剧为横跨背部中段并放射至双侧侧腹的锐利带状疼痛，目前评分为8/10，且不再能通过通常剂量的羟考酮缓解。她表示今天早上试图走到卫生间时，觉得双腿“沉重且笨拙”，并绊倒了两次。她否认近期有任何跌倒或外伤史。她显得焦虑，非常安静地躺在床上，不愿移动，因为移动会加重疼痛。她说自己已经三天没有排便，但她将此归因于使用了阿片类药物。她注意到今天早上排尿时，尿流似乎很细，并且感觉膀胱没有完全排空。

title.zh: 评估结果与实验室数据

content.en:
Baseline vital signs: temperature 98.8 °F (37.1 °C), heart rate 92 beats per minute, blood pressure 138/82 mmHg, respiratory rate 18 breaths per minute, SpO₂ 96% on room air. She is alert and oriented to person, place, time, and situation. Cranial nerves are intact. Upper extremity strength is 5 out of 5 bilaterally with normal sensation. Lower extremity motor strength is 4 out of 5 bilaterally in hip flexors and quadriceps and 4 minus out of 5 in ankle dorsiflexors, with the left side slightly weaker than the right. She has difficulty lifting her legs against gravity with sustained resistance. Deep tendon reflexes at the patellar tendons are hyperreflexic (3+) bilaterally; Achilles reflexes are 3+ bilaterally. Babinski sign is equivocal on the right and extensor (positive, upgoing toe) on the left. Sensation to light touch and pinprick is diminished below approximately the T8 dermatome, with a vague band of hyperesthesia at the T6–T7 level. Proprioception in the great toes is mildly reduced bilaterally. She has point tenderness on palpation over the T6 and T8 spinous processes. Rectal tone is present but diminished on exam performed by the admitting provider. A bladder scan shows a post-void residual of 280 mL. Skin is intact, warm, and dry. She has mild bilateral lower extremity edema (1+), which she says is chronic.

Baseline labs: WBC 6.8 ×10³/µL, hemoglobin 10.8 g/dL, platelets 188 ×10³/µL, sodium 141 mEq/L, potassium 4.2 mEq/L, chloride 102 mEq/L, bicarbonate 24 mEq/L, BUN 18 mg/dL, creatinine 0.9 mg/dL, calcium (corrected) 10.1 mg/dL, albumin 3.2 g/dL, alkaline phosphatase 312 U/L (elevated, consistent with bone metastases), ALT 28 U/L, AST 32 U/L, glucose 118 mg/dL, PT/INR 1.0, aPTT 29 seconds. Urinalysis is unremarkable.

基线生命体征：体温98.8 °F (37.1 °C)，心率92次/分，血压138/82 mmHg，呼吸频率18次/分，室内空气下SpO₂ 96%。患者神志清醒，对人物、地点、时间和情境的定向力正常。脑神经完整。双侧上肢肌力5/5级，感觉正常。双侧下肢髋屈肌和股四头肌肌力4/5级，踝背屈肌力4-/5级，左侧比右侧稍弱。她在持续阻力下抬起双腿抗重力时有困难。双侧髌腱深反射亢进（3+）；双侧跟腱反射3+。右侧巴宾斯基征可疑，左侧呈伸性（阳性，拇趾上翘）。约T8皮节以下的轻触觉和痛觉减退，T6–T7水平有模糊的痛觉过敏带。双侧大脚趾的本体感觉轻度减退。触诊T6和T8棘突有压痛。接诊医生检查发现直肠括约肌张力存在但减弱。膀胱扫描显示残余尿量为280 mL。皮肤完整，温暖，干燥。有轻度双侧下肢水肿（1+），她表示这是慢性的。

基线实验室数据：白细胞6.8 ×10³/µL，血红蛋白10.8 g/dL，血小板188 ×10³/µL，钠141 mEq/L，钾4.2 mEq/L，氯102 mEq/L，碳酸氢盐24 mEq/L，血尿素氮（BUN）18 mg/dL，肌酐0.9 mg/dL，校正钙10.1 mg/dL，白蛋白3.2 g/dL，碱性磷酸酶312 U/L（升高，与骨转移一致），ALT 28 U/L，AST 32 U/L，血糖118 mg/dL，PT/INR 1.0，aPTT 29秒。尿液分析无异常。

title.zh: 临床病程 — 入院后3小时

content.en: The MRI results return and confirm an epidural mass at T7 with significant spinal cord compression. The tumor is arising from the known T6 and T8 vertebral body metastases and is causing greater than 50 percent canal narrowing with cord edema and signal change on T2-weighted images. There is no evidence of spinal instability or fracture-dislocation. The oncologist and neurosurgeon are notified. The provider orders an immediate increase of dexamethasone to 10 mg IV bolus now, followed by 4 mg IV every 6 hours (urgent MSCC dexamethasone protocol). The nurse reassesses the patient after the MRI and finds the following changes: pain has increased to 9 out of 10 despite receiving oxycodone 10 mg PO one hour ago. Lower extremity motor strength has declined to 3 out of 5 bilaterally in hip flexors and quadriceps and 3 minus out of 5 in ankle dorsiflexors. She can no longer lift her legs against gravity with sustained resistance and has noticeable foot drop on the left. Sensory level has risen slightly, with diminished sensation now beginning at the T7 dermatome. She reports new numbness in her perineal area. A repeat bladder scan, performed because the patient has not voided despite adequate fluid intake over 3 hours, shows 420 mL. Vital signs: temperature 99 °F (37.2 °C), heart rate 98, blood pressure 142/86, respiratory rate 20, SpO₂ 95% on room air. She is increasingly anxious, tearful, and asking, "Am I going to be paralyzed?"
content.zh: MRI结果返回，证实T7处有一个硬膜外肿块，伴有明显的脊髓压迫。肿瘤起源于已知的T6和T8椎体转移灶，导致超过50%的椎管狭窄，在T2加权图像上可见脊髓水肿和信号改变。没有脊柱不稳或骨折脱位的证据。已通知肿瘤科医生和神经外科医生。医生下达医嘱，立即将地塞米松增加至10 mg静脉推注（即刻），随后每6小时静脉注射4 mg（紧急MSCC地塞米松方案）。护士在MRI检查后重新评估患者，发现以下变化：尽管一小时前口服了10 mg羟考酮，疼痛已加剧至9/10。双侧下肢髋屈肌和股四头肌肌力下降至3/5级，踝背屈肌力下降至3-/5级。她不再能在持续阻力下抬起双腿抗重力，且左侧有明显的足下垂。感觉平面略有上升，感觉减退现在从T7皮节开始。她报告会阴区新出现麻木感。由于患者在过去3小时内摄入了充足的液体但仍未排尿，再次进行了膀胱扫描，结果显示为420 mL。生命体征：体温99 °F (37.2 °C)，心率98次/分，血压142/86 mmHg，呼吸频率20次/分，室内空气下SpO₂ 95%。她越来越焦虑、流泪，并问道：“我会瘫痪吗？”

title.zh: 临床病程 — 入院后8小时

content.en: The dexamethasone bolus was administered and the scheduled doses are running. A radiation oncology consult has been placed, and a neurosurgical consult is evaluating the patient for possible surgical decompression versus emergent radiation. The nurse has obtained an order for and placed an indwelling urinary catheter, which drained 550 mL of clear yellow urine on insertion. Pain management has been escalated: the provider has ordered a hydromorphone PCA pump (0.2 mg demand dose, 6-minute lockout, no basal rate). The patient's pain is now 6 out of 10 on the PCA, improved from 9 out of 10. However, the neurological examination continues to worsen: lower extremity motor strength is now 2 out of 5 bilaterally — she can only move her legs with gravity eliminated. Ankle dorsiflexion is 1 out of 5 on the left and 2 out of 5 on the right. She cannot wiggle her left toes on command. Deep tendon reflexes at the patellar tendons are now 4+ with clonus (3 beats) at both ankles. Babinski sign is clearly positive (upgoing) bilaterally. Sensory level has risen to approximately T6; she reports she cannot feel the nurse's touch below her nipple line on the left and only vaguely on the right. Perineal sensation is absent. Rectal tone, when re-evaluated by the provider, is now absent. Vital signs: temperature 99.7 °F (37.6 °C), heart rate 86 beats/min; lower than prior after improved pain control and reduced anxiety. Blood pressure 136/80 mmHg, respiratory rate 18, SpO₂ 96% on room air. Blood glucose check is 186 mg/dL (steroid-induced hyperglycemia). Repeat calcium (corrected) is 10.8 mg/dL — trending upward. The neurosurgeon recommends emergent surgical decompression (posterior laminectomy at T6–T8) given the rapid neurological decline, to be followed by postoperative radiation. Surgery is scheduled for this evening. The patient and her family are distressed; her adult daughter asks the nurse whether surgery will make her mother walk again.
content.zh: 地塞米松推注已给药，计划剂量正在执行。已安排放射肿瘤科会诊，神经外科会诊正在评估患者以决定是进行手术减压还是紧急放疗。护士已获得医嘱并留置了导尿管，插入时引流出550 mL清澈黄色尿液。疼痛管理已升级：医生下达了氢吗啡酮PCA泵医嘱（需求剂量0.2 mg，锁定时间6分钟，无基础率）。患者在使用PCA后疼痛现为6/10，较之前的9/10有所改善。然而，神经系统检查结果继续恶化：双侧下肢肌力现在为2/5级——她只能在消除重力的情况下移动双腿。左侧踝背屈肌力为1/5级，右侧为2/5级。她无法按指令扭动左脚趾。双侧髌腱深反射现在为4+，双侧踝关节均有阵挛（3次）。双侧巴宾斯基征呈明显阳性（上翘）。感觉平面已上升至约T6；她报告说无法感觉到护士触摸左侧乳头线以下，右侧感觉也很模糊。会阴感觉缺失。医生再次评估时，直肠括约肌张力现已缺失。生命体征：体温99.7 °F (37.6 °C)，心率86次/分（较前降低，在疼痛控制改善和焦虑减轻后），血压136/80 mmHg，呼吸频率18次/分，室内空气下SpO₂ 96%。血糖检查为186 mg/dL（类固醇诱导的高血糖）。复查校正钙为10.8 mg/dL——呈上升趋势。鉴于神经功能迅速下降，神经外科医生建议进行紧急手术减压（T6–T8后路椎板切除术），随后进行术后放疗。手术安排在今晚进行。患者及其家属十分悲痛；她的成年女儿问护士手术是否能让她母亲再次行走。

title.zh: 临床病程 — 术后第1天

content.en: Approximately 30 hours after admission (roughly 18 hours after posterior laminectomy): The patient is transferred back to the oncology unit from the PACU. She is awake, alert, and oriented. Surgical site dressing at the posterior thoracic spine is clean, dry, and intact with a Jackson-Pratt drain in place with 40 mL of serosanguineous output over the past 8 hours. Vital signs: temperature 100 °F (37.8 °C), heart rate 78, blood pressure 124/74, respiratory rate 16, SpO₂ 97% on 2 L nasal cannula. Pain is 5 out of 10 at the surgical site, managed on IV hydromorphone. On neurological reassessment: lower extremity motor strength is now 3 out of 5 bilaterally in hip flexors and quadriceps — improved from the 2 out of 5 seen preoperatively. Ankle dorsiflexion is 2 out of 5 bilaterally (improved on the left from 1 out of 5). She can wiggle all toes weakly on command. Deep tendon reflexes remain hyperreflexic (3+) but clonus is no longer sustained — only 1 beat at the left ankle, absent on the right. Babinski sign remains positive bilaterally. Sensory level has improved: she now perceives light touch beginning at T8 and pinprick at T9. Perineal sensation remains absent. The indwelling urinary catheter remains in place, draining clear yellow urine at 60 mL per hour. Blood glucose is 210 mg/dL; a sliding-scale insulin order is in place. Repeat labs: hemoglobin 9.6 g/dL (dropped from 10.8, expected surgical loss), creatinine 0.9 mg/dL (stable), corrected calcium 10.4 mg/dL (slightly improved from 10.8, bisphosphonate and steroids helping), alkaline phosphatase 298 U/L (stable). The dexamethasone is continued at 4 mg IV every 6 hours with a planned taper over the coming weeks. Radiation oncology plans to initiate adjuvant radiation to the T6–T8 field in 10 to 14 days once the surgical wound has begun to heal. The patient's mood is cautiously hopeful. She asks the nurse, "Will I need to learn to use a wheelchair?"
content.zh: 入院后约30小时（后路椎板切除术后约18小时）：患者从PACU转回肿瘤科病房。她神志清醒，定向力正常。胸椎后部手术部位敷料清洁、干燥、完好，留置的Jackson-Pratt引流管在过去8小时内引流出40 mL血清血液性液体。生命体征：体温100 °F (37.8 °C)，心率78次/分，血压124/74 mmHg，呼吸频率16次/分，鼻导管2 L吸氧下SpO₂ 97%。手术部位疼痛为5/10，通过静脉注射氢吗啡酮控制。在神经系统重新评估中：双侧下肢髋屈肌和股四头肌肌力现为3/5级——较术前的2/5级有所改善。双侧踝背屈肌力为2/5级（左侧从1/5级改善）。她能按指令微弱地扭动所有脚趾。深反射仍亢进（3+），但阵挛不再持续——左侧踝关节仅有1次搏动，右侧无。双侧巴宾斯基征仍呈阳性。感觉平面已改善：她现在能感知T8开始的轻触觉和T9开始的痛觉。会阴感觉仍缺失。留置导尿管继续使用，以60 mL/小时的速度引流出清澈黄色尿液。血糖为210 mg/dL；已下达滑动胰岛素医嘱。复查实验室数据：血红蛋白9.6 g/dL（从10.8下降，符合预期的手术丢失），肌酐0.9 mg/dL（稳定），校正钙10.4 mg/dL（从10.8略有改善，双膦酸盐和类固醇起效），碱性磷酸酶298 U/L（稳定）。地塞米松以4 mg每6小时静脉注射继续使用，计划在未来几周内逐渐减量。放射肿瘤科计划在手术伤口开始愈合后的10到14天内对T6–T8区域启动辅助放疗。患者的情绪谨慎乐观。她问护士：“我需要学习使用轮椅吗？”

stem.en: At Stage 1, the patient's bladder scan shows 420 mL of urine and she has new perineal numbness. The nurse should recognize that these findings indicate which of the following?
stem.zh: 在阶段1，患者的膀胱扫描显示有420 mL尿液，且新出现了会阴部麻木。护士应认识到这些发现提示以下哪种情况？

stem.en: Review the Clinical Course at Stage 2. The neurosurgeon recommends emergent surgical decompression. Which of the following actions should the nurse take to safely prepare the patient for surgery? Select all that apply.
stem.zh: 查阅阶段2的临床病程。神经外科医生建议进行紧急手术减压。护士应采取以下哪些措施来安全地为患者做好手术准备？请选择所有适用项。

stem.en: At Stage 2, the patient's daughter asks the nurse, "Will surgery make my mother walk again?" Which is the most appropriate response by the nurse?
stem.zh: 在阶段2，患者的女儿问护士：“手术能让我母亲再次走路吗？”护士最恰当的回答是哪一项？

stem.en: At Stage 3 (postoperative day 1), the nurse evaluates the patient's neurological response to surgery. For each assessment finding, specify whether it indicates an improvement from the preoperative baseline or indicates persistent spinal cord dysfunction.
stem.zh: 在阶段3（术后第1天），护士评估患者对手术的神经系统反应。针对以下每项评估发现，请指明它是表明较术前基线有所改善，还是表明存在持续的脊髓功能障碍。

stem.en: Review the patient's baseline assessment findings. The nurse should recognize that the combination of escalating mid-back pain, new bilateral leg weakness, and sensory/bladder changes is most highly suggestive of which oncologic emergency?
stem.zh: 查阅患者的基线评估结果。护士应认识到，背部中段疼痛加剧、新发双侧下肢无力以及感觉/膀胱改变的综合表现，最强烈提示以下哪种肿瘤科急症？

options.en: Opioid-induced neurotoxicity
options.zh: 阿片类药物引起的神经毒性

options.en: Malignant spinal cord compression
options.zh: 恶性脊髓压迫

options.en: Paraneoplastic cerebellar degeneration
options.zh: 副肿瘤性小脑变性

options.en: Hypercalcemia of malignancy
options.zh: 恶性高钙血症

correct.en: The combination of escalating back pain at the level of known metastases, new motor weakness with upper motor neuron signs (hyperreflexia, positive Babinski), a definable sensory level, and autonomic (bladder) dysfunction is the classic presentation of malignant spinal cord compression. This is an oncologic emergency requiring urgent intervention.
correct.zh: 已知转移病灶水平的背痛加剧、伴有上运动神经元体征（反射亢进、巴宾斯基征阳性）的新发运动无力、明确的感觉平面以及自主神经（膀胱）功能障碍的综合表现，是恶性脊髓压迫的典型表现。这是一种需要紧急干预的肿瘤科急症。

byChoice.en: While the patient has bone metastases and a slightly elevated corrected calcium (10.1 mg/dL), hypercalcemia primarily presents with generalized weakness, lethargy, confusion, nausea, and polyuria—not a specific sensory level, focal upper motor neuron signs, or escalating focal back pain.
byChoice.zh: 虽然患者有骨转移且校正钙略有升高（10.1 mg/dL），但高钙血症主要表现为全身无力、嗜睡、意识模糊、恶心和多尿——而不是特定的感觉平面、局灶性上运动神经元体征或局灶性背痛加剧。

byChoice.en: Paraneoplastic cerebellar degeneration presents with ataxia, dysarthria, and nystagmus, not an ascending spinal cord syndrome with a distinct sensory level.
byChoice.zh: 副肿瘤性小脑变性表现为共济失调、构音障碍和眼球震颤，而不是具有明显感觉平面的上行性脊髓综合征。

byChoice.en: This correctly identifies the classic triad of spinal cord compression: localized pain, followed by motor and sensory deficits, leading to autonomic dysfunction.
byChoice.zh: 这正确识别了脊髓压迫的典型三联征：局部疼痛，随后出现运动和感觉障碍，进而导致自主神经功能障碍。

byChoice.en: Opioid neurotoxicity can cause sedation, myoclonus, and hyperalgesia, but it does not cause a distinct sensory level, focal upper motor neuron signs, or localized radicular back pain.
byChoice.zh: 阿片类神经毒性可引起镇静、肌阵挛和痛觉过敏，但不会引起明显的感觉平面、局灶性上运动神经元体征或局部神经根性背痛。

testTakingStrategy.en: Recognize that a distinct sensory level (e.g., T8) combined with motor weakness and bowel/bladder changes strongly points to a spinal cord lesion rather than a systemic or metabolic issue.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 要认识到，明显的感觉平面（例如T8）结合运动无力和排便/排尿改变，强烈提示脊髓病变，而不是全身性或代谢性问题。

stem.en: Review the patient's Clinical Course at Stage 1. Which action is the nurse's immediate priority?
stem.zh: 查阅患者在阶段1的临床病程。哪项操作是护士的当务之急？

options.en: Provide emotional support and reassurance regarding the risk of paralysis
options.zh: 就瘫痪的风险提供情感支持和安抚

options.en: Administer the IV dexamethasone bolus as prescribed
options.zh: 按医嘱给予静脉地塞米松推注

options.en: Perform a complete head-to-toe nursing assessment
options.zh: 进行全面的从头到脚护理评估

options.en: Prepare the patient for the insertion of an indwelling urinary catheter
options.zh: 准备为患者插入留置导尿管

correct.en: Administering the urgent MSCC dexamethasone dose is the highest-priority pharmacological intervention for malignant spinal cord compression and should not be delayed. It reduces vasogenic edema surrounding the compressed cord, which can halt or slow neurological deterioration while awaiting definitive treatment.
correct.zh: 给予紧急MSCC地塞米松剂量是恶性脊髓压迫的最高优先级药理干预措施，不应延误。它能减少受压脊髓周围的血管源性水肿，从而在等待确定性治疗时阻止或减缓神经功能恶化。

byChoice.en: Emotional support is a vital nursing role, but administering the medication that actually prevents further spinal cord damage must occur first.
byChoice.zh: 情感支持是护理的重要职责，但必须首先给予切实防止脊髓进一步损伤的药物。

byChoice.en: While performing a focused baseline neurological assessment is crucial to track the trajectory, a full routine head-to-toe assessment should not delay the administration of the emergent medication.
byChoice.zh: 虽然进行重点基线神经系统评估对跟踪病情变化轨迹至关重要，但常规的全面从头到脚评估不应延误紧急药物的给药。

byChoice.en: Catheter insertion is indicated for the patient's urinary retention (420 mL post-void residual) to prevent bladder injury, but medication administration to protect the spinal cord takes priority.
byChoice.zh: 针对患者的尿潴留（残余尿量420 mL），有指征进行导尿以防止膀胱损伤，但保护脊髓的药物给药应优先进行。

byChoice.en: Dexamethasone is the first-line emergent intervention to reduce cord edema and preserve neurologic function. Time is critical.
byChoice.zh: 地塞米松是减少脊髓水肿和保护神经功能的首选紧急干预措施。时间至关重要。

testTakingStrategy.en: When key assessment data already identify an emergency and a time-sensitive medication is prescribed, do not delay treatment for a routine full assessment.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 当关键评估资料已经提示急症，且已开具具有时间敏感性的药物医嘱时，不要为了常规全面评估而延误治疗。

stem.en: At Stage 1, the patient's bladder scan shows 420 mL of urine and she has new perineal numbness. The nurse should recognize that these findings indicate which of the following?
stem.zh: 在阶段1，患者的膀胱扫描显示有420 mL尿液，且新出现了会阴部麻木。护士应认识到这些发现提示以下哪种情况？

options.en: A localized urinary tract infection secondary to impaired mobility
options.zh: 继发于活动能力受损的局部尿路感染

options.en: An expected adverse effect of her recent oxycodone administration
options.zh: 她近期服用羟考酮的预期不良反应

options.en: Dehydration requiring an increase in her IV fluid rate
options.zh: 脱水，需要增加其静脉输液速度

options.en: Interruption of descending autonomic pathways indicating progressive spinal cord compression
options.zh: 下行自主神经通路中断，提示进行性脊髓压迫

correct.en: Urinary retention in the context of thoracic spinal cord compression reflects the interruption of descending autonomic pathways. It is an ominous neurological finding when accompanied by worsening lower-extremity weakness, a rising sensory level, and new perineal sensory change.
correct.zh: 在胸髓压迫的情况下，尿潴留反映了下行自主神经通路的中断。当伴有下肢无力加重、感觉平面上升和新发的会阴感觉改变时，这是一个不祥的神经系统发现。

byChoice.en: Dehydration would present with low urine volume in the bladder (oliguria), not urinary retention with a high post-void residual volume.
byChoice.zh: 脱水会表现为膀胱内尿量少（少尿），而不是伴有高残余尿量的尿潴留。

byChoice.en: A UTI would typically cause dysuria, frequency, or fever, and her baseline urinalysis was unremarkable. It would not explain the perineal numbness.
byChoice.zh: 尿路感染通常会引起排尿困难、尿频或发热，且其基线尿液分析无异常。它无法解释会阴部麻木。

byChoice.en: While opioids can cause urinary retention, attributing these findings solely to the medication misses the concurrent ascending sensory deficits and motor decline, leading to a dangerous underestimation of the neurologic emergency.
byChoice.zh: 虽然阿片类药物可引起尿潴留，但如果将这些发现仅仅归因于药物，就会忽略同时出现的上行性感觉障碍和运动能力下降，从而导致对神经系统急症危险程度的严重低估。

byChoice.en: This accurately attributes the autonomic dysfunction (urinary retention) to the worsening spinal cord compression.
byChoice.zh: 这准确地将自主神经功能障碍（尿潴留）归因于不断恶化的脊髓压迫。

testTakingStrategy.en: When a symptom (retention) occurs alongside localizing neurologic signs (sensory level, perineal numbness), trace the symptom to the central neurologic lesion rather than a side effect.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 当症状（尿潴留）与定位性神经体征（感觉平面、会阴麻木）同时出现时，应将症状追溯至中枢神经系统病变，而非副作用。

stem.en: Review the Clinical Course at Stage 2. The neurosurgeon recommends emergent surgical decompression. Which of the following actions should the nurse take to safely prepare the patient for surgery? Select all that apply.
stem.zh: 查阅阶段2的临床病程。神经外科医生建议进行紧急手术减压。护士应采取以下哪些措施来安全地为患者做好手术准备？请选择所有适用项。

options.en: Explain the surgical risks and prognostic outcome of the laminectomy to the family.
options.zh: 向家属解释椎板切除术的手术风险和预后结果。

options.en: Verify that the surgeon has discussed the procedure and obtained informed consent.
options.zh: 核实外科医生已讨论了手术程序并获得了知情同意。

options.en: Ensure current laboratories, a type and screen, and imaging are available.
options.zh: 确保有最新的实验室检查、血型和抗体筛查以及影像学资料。

options.en: Hold the scheduled enoxaparin dose and communicate this to the surgical team.
options.zh: 暂停预定的依诺肝素剂量，并将此情况传达给手术团队。

options.en: Continue serial neurological assessments to document the trajectory of decline.
options.zh: 继续进行连续的神经系统评估，以记录病情下降的轨迹。

options.en: Administer a stat dose of regular insulin to correct the steroid-induced hyperglycemia to a target of 100 mg/dL.
options.zh: 给予立即剂量的常规胰岛素，以将类固醇诱导的高血糖纠正至目标值100 mg/dL。

correct.en: Preparing a patient for emergent spinal decompression requires verifying informed consent, ensuring safety (holding anticoagulation), preparing necessary preoperative data (labs, imaging, type and screen), and continuing to monitor the rapid neurological decline. Holding the enoxaparin is critical to prevent epidural hematoma. The nurse's role in consent is to verify it was obtained by the provider, not to explain surgical risks or prognosticate.
correct.zh: 为患者进行紧急脊髓减压术做准备需要核实知情同意、确保安全（暂停抗凝治疗）、准备必要的术前数据（实验室检查、影像学、血型和抗体筛查），并继续监测迅速下降的神经功能。暂停依诺肝素对于预防硬膜外血肿至关重要。护士在知情同意中的作用是核实医生已获得同意，而不是解释手术风险或预测预后。

byChoice.en: Explaining surgical risks, benefits, and definitive prognostic outcomes is the responsibility of the surgeon, not within the nursing scope of practice.
byChoice.zh: 解释手术风险、益处和明确的预后结果是外科医生的责任，不在护理执业范围之内。

byChoice.en: The nurse acts as a patient advocate and witness by verifying that the surgeon has provided the information and the patient has consented.
byChoice.zh: 护士通过核实外科医生已提供信息且患者已同意，充当患者的倡导者和见证人。

byChoice.en: These are standard, essential preoperative safety checks, especially given the potential for blood loss in spinal tumor surgery.
byChoice.zh: 这些是标准且必要的术前安全检查，特别是考虑到脊柱肿瘤手术可能会有失血。

byChoice.en: Administering anticoagulation (enoxaparin) immediately before spinal surgery increases the risk of catastrophic bleeding and epidural hematoma. It must be held.
byChoice.zh: 在脊柱手术前立即给予抗凝治疗（依诺肝素）会增加灾难性出血和硬膜外血肿的风险。必须暂停。

byChoice.en: Ongoing assessment provides the surgical team with the most up-to-date trajectory, confirming the ongoing need for emergent intervention.
byChoice.zh: 持续评估为手术团队提供了最新的病情轨迹，证实了持续需要紧急干预。

byChoice.en: While the hyperglycemia (186 mg/dL) must be communicated to anesthesia and treated per protocol, tightly targeting 100 mg/dL with a stat insulin dose immediately pre-op risks severe intraoperative hypoglycemia.
byChoice.zh: 虽然高血糖（186 mg/dL）必须传达给麻醉科并按方案处理，但在术前立即给予常规胰岛素以严格达到100 mg/dL的目标会带来严重的术中低血糖风险。

testTakingStrategy.en: Differentiate between nursing responsibilities (verifying consent, holding contraindicated medications, monitoring) and provider responsibilities (obtaining informed consent, prognosticating).
testTakingStrategy.zh: 区分护理职责（核实知情同意、停用有禁忌的药物、监测）和医生职责（获取知情同意、预测预后）。

stem.en: At Stage 2, the patient's daughter asks the nurse, "Will surgery make my mother walk again?" Which is the most appropriate response by the nurse?
stem.zh: 在阶段2，患者的女儿问护士：“手术能让我母亲再次走路吗？”护士最恰当的回答是哪一项？

options.en: "I understand how frightening this is. The goal of surgery is to take pressure off the spinal cord and prevent further neurologic loss. Some patients regain function, and the fact that your mother still has some leg movement is encouraging, but the neurosurgeon is the best person to discuss expected recovery."
options.zh: “我理解这有多令人害怕。手术的目的是减轻对脊髓的压迫，防止神经功能进一步丧失。有些患者会恢复功能，你母亲的腿还有一些活动能力这是令人鼓舞的，但神经外科医生是讨论预期恢复情况的最佳人选。”

options.en: "The damage from the tumor is usually permanent. Surgery is just a palliative measure to reduce pain, so she will likely need a wheelchair."
options.zh: “肿瘤造成的损伤通常是永久性的。手术只是一种减轻疼痛的姑息性措施，所以她很可能需要轮椅。”

options.en: "Don't worry, the neurosurgeon is highly skilled. The surgery will fix the compression and she will be able to walk again after rehabilitation."
options.zh: “别担心，神经外科医生医术高超。手术将解决压迫问题，她在康复后将能再次行走。”

options.en: "I am not allowed to discuss her prognosis with you. You must wait until the surgeon comes out of the operating room."
options.zh: “我不能和你讨论她的预后。你必须等到外科医生从手术室出来。”

correct.en: This response balances honesty, empathy, and safe nursing boundaries. It correctly identifies the primary goal of surgery (preventing further loss), provides grounded hope based on clinical data (remaining motor function is a good prognostic sign), and appropriately refers definitive prognostication to the surgeon.
correct.zh: 这个回答平衡了诚实、同理心和安全的护理界限。它正确地指出了手术的主要目标（防止进一步的丧失），基于临床数据提供了有根据的希望（保留的运动功能是良好的预后标志），并适当地将明确的预后预测交给外科医生。

byChoice.en: While the nurse cannot offer a definitive prognosis, this response is abrupt, non-therapeutic, and dismissive of the family's severe emotional distress.
byChoice.zh: 虽然护士不能提供明确的预后，但这回答过于生硬、缺乏治疗性，且无视了家属严重的精神痛苦。

byChoice.en: This provides false reassurance and makes a guarantee about recovery that the nurse cannot promise, violating veracity and scope of practice.
byChoice.zh: 这提供了虚假的安慰，并对恢复做出了护士无法承诺的保证，违反了真实性原则和执业范围。

byChoice.en: This is overly pessimistic, inaccurate (surgery aims to decompress, and recovery is possible, especially since she has some residual motor function), and destroys hope.
byChoice.zh: 这过于悲观且不准确（手术旨在减压，并且有可能恢复，特别是考虑到她还有一些残余运动功能），摧毁了希望。

byChoice.en: This provides therapeutic communication, accurate general information, and refers the specific prognostic question to the provider.
byChoice.zh: 这提供了治疗性沟通、准确的一般信息，并将具体的预后问题转交给医生。

testTakingStrategy.en: Avoid responses that offer false reassurance or definitive prognostic guarantees, but also avoid shutting down communication. Choose responses that state factual goals and refer to the provider for specifics.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 避免提供虚假安慰或明确预后保证的回答，但也要避免终止沟通。选择陈述事实目标并将具体细节转交给医生的回答。

stem.en: At Stage 3 (postoperative day 1), the nurse evaluates the patient's neurological response to surgery. For each assessment finding, specify whether it indicates an improvement from the preoperative baseline or indicates persistent spinal cord dysfunction.
stem.zh: 在阶段3（术后第1天），护士评估患者对手术的神经系统反应。针对以下每项评估发现，请指明它是表明较术前基线有所改善，还是表明存在持续的脊髓功能障碍。

rows.en: Bilateral lower extremity motor strength is 3 out of 5

rows.zh: 双侧巴宾斯基征仍为阳性

correct.en: Evaluation requires serial comparison. Preoperatively, motor strength had dropped to 2/5; 3/5 is an improvement. The sensory level had risen to T6; dropping back to T8–T9 is an improvement. However, positive Babinski signs reflect persistent upper motor neuron damage, and absent perineal sensation reflects persistent autonomic/sacral dysfunction, which typically recovers last.
correct.zh: 评估需要进行连续比较。术前，肌力已降至2/5级；3/5级是一种改善。感觉平面曾上升至T6；回落至T8–T9是一种改善。然而，巴宾斯基征阳性反映了持续的上运动神经元损伤，而会阴感觉缺失反映了持续的自主神经/骶神经功能障碍，这通常是最后恢复的。

byChoice.en: Motor strength was 2/5 (unable to lift against gravity) prior to surgery and is now 3/5 (can move against gravity). This demonstrates functional improvement.
byChoice.zh: 手术前肌力为2/5级（不能抗重力抬起），现在为3/5级（能抗重力移动）。这表明功能有所改善。

byChoice.en: A positive Babinski sign is an abnormal upper motor neuron reflex indicating that corticospinal tract dysfunction persists.
byChoice.zh: 巴宾斯基征阳性是一种异常的上运动神经元反射，表明皮质脊髓束功能障碍持续存在。

byChoice.en: The sensory loss had ascended to the T6 level preoperatively. The lowering of the level back down to T8–T9 demonstrates improved sensory pathway function.
byChoice.zh: 术前感觉丧失平面已上升至T6水平。该平面回落至T8–T9表明感觉通路功能有所改善。

byChoice.en: Perineal sensation was lost as compression worsened. Its continued absence indicates that sacral-mediated perineal/autonomic function has not yet recovered.
byChoice.zh: 随着压迫加重，会阴感觉丧失。其持续缺失表明由骶段介导的会阴/自主神经功能尚未恢复。

testTakingStrategy.en: Compare the current assessment data directly against the data from the worst point in the clinical course (Stage 2) to determine if a finding represents an improvement or persistent pathology.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 将当前的评估数据与临床病程中最差的时间点（阶段2）的数据直接进行比较，以确定某项发现代表的是改善还是持续的病理状态。

evidenceCatalog.text: Review the client record and answer the case-study items.
查看患者病历并回答病例分析题。
Spinal cord compression from metastatic cancer
转移性癌症引起的脊髓压迫

A 61-year-old woman with a three-year history of stage IV non-small cell lung cancer with known osseous metastases to the thoracic spine (T6, T8) and ribs is admitted to the oncology unit from the emergency department. She was diagnosed with bone metastases eight months ago and has been receiving palliative radiation and systemic therapy. She has a history of well-controlled hypertension managed with amlodipine 5 mg daily and a 30-pack-year smoking history. Home medications include dexamethasone 4 mg PO daily (recently tapered from a higher dose after her last radiation cycle), oxycodone 10 mg PO every 6 hours as needed for back pain, ondansetron 4 mg PO every 8 hours as needed, enoxaparin 40 mg subcutaneous daily for VTE prophylaxis, and a bisphosphonate infusion monthly. She presents because her back pain has changed in character and intensity over the past 48 hours, and she is having new difficulty walking. Current admission orders include IV normal saline at 75 mL/hr, continuation of home medications, neurological checks every 4 hours, fall precautions, and a stat MRI of the entire spine with and without contrast.

The patient reports that her usual mid-thoracic back pain, which she describes as a dull ache rated 4 out of 10 and typically relieved by oxycodone, has escalated over the past two days to a sharp, band-like pain across her mid-back radiating around both flanks, now rated 8 out of 10 and no longer relieved by her usual oxycodone dose. She states that this morning she noticed her legs felt "heavy and clumsy" when she tried to walk to the bathroom, and she stumbled twice. She denies any recent falls or trauma. The combination of escalating back pain at the level of known metastases, new motor weakness with upper motor neuron signs (hyperreflexia, positive Babinski), a definable sensory level, and autonomic (bladder) dysfunction is the classic presentation of malignant spinal cord compression. This is an oncologic emergency requiring urgent intervention.
已知转移病灶水平的背痛加剧、伴有上运动神经元体征（反射亢进、巴宾斯基征阳性）的新发运动无力、明确的感觉平面以及自主神经（膀胱）功能障碍的综合表现，是恶性脊髓压迫的典型表现。这是一种需要紧急干预的肿瘤科急症。

While the patient has bone metastases and a slightly elevated corrected calcium (10.1 mg/dL), hypercalcemia primarily presents with generalized weakness, lethargy, confusion, nausea, and polyuria—not a specific sensory level, focal upper motor neuron signs, or escalating focal back pain.
虽然患者有骨转移且校正钙略有升高（10.1 mg/dL），但高钙血症主要表现为全身无力、嗜睡、意识模糊、恶心和多尿——而不是特定的感觉平面、局灶性上运动神经元体征或局灶性背痛加剧。
Paraneoplastic cerebellar degeneration presents with ataxia, dysarthria, and nystagmus, not an ascending spinal cord syndrome with a distinct sensory level.
副肿瘤性小脑变性表现为共济失调、构音障碍和眼球震颤，而不是具有明显感觉平面的上行性脊髓综合征。
This correctly identifies the classic triad of spinal cord compression: localized pain, followed by motor and sensory deficits, leading to autonomic dysfunction.
这正确识别了脊髓压迫的典型三联征：局部疼痛，随后出现运动和感觉障碍，进而导致自主神经功能障碍。
Opioid neurotoxicity can cause sedation, myoclonus, and hyperalgesia, but it does not cause a distinct sensory level, focal upper motor neuron signs, or localized radicular back pain.
阿片类神经毒性可引起镇静、肌阵挛和痛觉过敏，但不会引起明显的感觉平面、局灶性上运动神经元体征或局部神经根性背痛。
Recognize that a distinct sensory level (e.g., T8) combined with motor weakness and bowel/bladder changes strongly points to a spinal cord lesion rather than a systemic or metabolic issue.
要认识到，明显的感觉平面（例如T8）结合运动无力和排便/排尿改变，强烈提示脊髓病变，而不是全身性或代谢性问题。

It reduces vasogenic edema surrounding the compressed cord, which can halt or slow neurological deterioration while awaiting definitive treatment.

Emotional support is a vital nursing role, but administering the medication that actually prevents further spinal cord damage must occur first.

Dexamethasone is the first-line emergent intervention to reduce cord edema and preserve neurologic function. Time is critical.
地塞米松是减少脊髓水肿和保护神经功能的首选紧急干预措施。时间至关重要。

Urinary retention in the context of thoracic spinal cord compression reflects the interruption of descending autonomic pathways. It is an ominous neurological finding when accompanied by worsening lower-extremity weakness, a rising sensory level, and new perineal sensory change.
在胸髓压迫的情况下，尿潴留反映了下行自主神经通路的中断。当伴有下肢无力加重、感觉平面上升和新发的会阴感觉改变时，这是一个不祥的神经系统发现。
Dehydration would present with low urine volume in the bladder (oliguria), not urinary retention with a high post-void residual volume.
脱水会表现为膀胱内尿量少（少尿），而不是伴有高残余尿量的尿潴留。
A UTI would typically cause dysuria, frequency, or fever, and her baseline urinalysis was unremarkable. It would not explain the perineal numbness.
尿路感染通常会引起排尿困难、尿频或发热，且其基线尿液分析无异常。它无法解释会阴部麻木。

While opioids can cause urinary retention, attributing these findings solely to the medication misses the concurrent ascending sensory deficits and motor decline, leading to a dangerous underestimation of the neurologic emergency.
虽然阿片类药物可引起尿潴留，但如果将这些发现仅仅归因于药物，就会忽略同时出现的上行性感觉障碍和运动能力下降，从而导致对神经系统急症危险程度的严重低估。
This accurately attributes the autonomic dysfunction (urinary retention) to the worsening spinal cord compression.
这准确地将自主神经功能障碍（尿潴留）归因于不断恶化的脊髓压迫。
When a symptom (retention) occurs alongside localizing neurologic signs (sensory level, perineal numbness), trace the symptom to the central neurologic lesion rather than a side effect.
当症状（尿潴留）与定位性神经体征（感觉平面、会阴麻木）同时出现时，应将症状追溯至中枢神经系统病变，而非副作用。

Preparing a patient for emergent spinal decompression requires verifying informed consent, ensuring safety (holding anticoagulation), preparing necessary preoperative data (labs, imaging, type and screen), and continuing to monitor the rapid neurological decline. Holding the enoxaparin is critical to prevent epidural hematoma. The nurse's role in consent is to verify it was obtained by the provider, not to explain surgical risks or prognosticate.
为患者进行紧急脊髓减压术做准备需要核实知情同意、确保安全（暂停抗凝治疗）、准备必要的术前数据（实验室检查、影像学、血型和抗体筛查），并继续监测迅速下降的神经功能。暂停依诺肝素对于预防硬膜外血肿至关重要。护士在知情同意中的作用是核实医生已获得同意，而不是解释手术风险或预测预后。
Explaining surgical risks, benefits, and definitive prognostic outcomes is the responsibility of the surgeon, not within the nursing scope of practice.
解释手术风险、益处和明确的预后结果是外科医生的责任，不在护理执业范围之内。
The nurse acts as a patient advocate and witness by verifying that the surgeon has provided the information and the patient has consented.
护士通过核实外科医生已提供信息且患者已同意，充当患者的倡导者和见证人。
These are standard, essential preoperative safety checks, especially given the potential for blood loss in spinal tumor surgery.
这些是标准且必要的术前安全检查，特别是考虑到脊柱肿瘤手术可能会有失血。
Administering anticoagulation (enoxaparin) immediately before spinal surgery increases the risk of catastrophic bleeding and epidural hematoma. It must be held.

Ongoing assessment provides the surgical team with the most up-to-date trajectory, confirming the ongoing need for emergent intervention.
